ai.scope: Codex assisted member B with the event workflow, HTTP adapter, PostgreSQL persistence, middle-platform Bearer and file adapters, simulated message adapter, automated tests, and trace evidence.
ai.disposition: Adopted after local tests and repository quality gates; simulated integration evidence remains explicitly separated from target-environment acceptance.

scope.evidence: The increment is limited to the selected G4-05 event/task closure ACs and does not claim unrelated G2-FR-001—029 implementation.

contract.evidence: Runtime implements the frozen Sprint 1 event/task list and command paths, accepts CONFIRMED, requires resourceVersion for mutations, and returns the complete ApiResponse envelope; tests/backend/g4-05-integration.test.mjs covers positive and negative cases.

authorizationAndValidation.evidence: tests/backend/g4-05-integration.test.mjs covers Bearer identity handshake, denied access, required fields, stale/missing resourceVersion, state preconditions, ownership, pagination, and idempotency conflict; invalid Bearer does not fall back to an unverified identity.

parameterizedAccess.evidence: backend/src/event-persistence.mjs and backend/src/idempotency.mjs use positional PostgreSQL parameters; automated tests assert parameter arrays.

secrets.evidence: Configuration contains placeholders only and is covered by npm run security:secrets.

logRedaction.evidence: Domain audit uses the G4-02 redacting audit sink; no headers, credentials, or full message content are logged.

migrationRollback.evidence: backend/migrations/002_event_workflow.up.sql and .down.sql are paired; tests/backend/foundation.test.mjs checks every added table in both directions.

tests.evidence: npm run test:backend:coverage passes 16/16 and covers Bearer, page-required routes, normal, unauthorized, idempotent, failure, timeout, database-backed service recreation, transactional rollback, post-commit dispatch, audit, and closure paths with global backend coverage above 70%; npm run test:g4-05:postgres passes 2/2 against an isolated PostgreSQL instance after migrations, including list, temporary-task and reminder persistence.

traceability.evidence: docs/work/C_REQ/rtm_g4_evidence.md maps selected ACs to implementation and tests; target-environment KN evidence stays pending.
